name: Earth Concrete
tagline: Warm concrete-grey paper with grid, crop marks, mono spec labels and one orange accent on black ink (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: Cement greys with black ink and a single signal-orange accent

typography.style: Heavy tight grotesk headlines, JetBrains Mono spec labels, crop marks and index numbers

best_for: Suits architecture, engineering and studio work that wants a blueprint-like, file-numbered look. Big black type and orange punctuation give strong hierarchy.
avoid_for: Avoid for soft, playful or emotional subjects.
